acceptedDifferences.decision: Use our native format and UI kit; do not import Velocity/Laravel Idea settings.
acceptedDifferences.scope: Template syntax/import compatibility only. Missing functional capabilities remain open.
Qodana/IntelliJ companion integration only; OpenIDEA plugin-only delivery retained. All other implementation remains in scope.
acceptedDifferences.reason: Qodana executes IntelliJ inspection plugins; current Wasm/OpenIDEA ABI is not a Qodana inspection adapter. User explicitly excluded a companion JVM deliverable. This is an accepted scope difference, not an unavailable OpenIDEA API.

evidence.reference: User decision2026-11-11: “Keep plugin-only; record Qodana as an exception”, reconfirmed “Exclude Qodana; keep plugin-only”.

qualifiedAPIFacts.fact: No public general FileAction apply call from webview; editor FileActions remain atomic/undoable.
Injection has range/language only; arbitrary virtual prefix/suffix cannot be expressed.
Raw native indexed replacement lacks plugin validation/escaping hook; reviewed typed FileActions remain possible.

qualifiedAPIFacts.finding: The pinned SDK provider/LanguageFeatures exports, execution interfaces and manifest contribution points expose no terminal input/completion-provider or terminal-spec hook. Keyed terminal execution/write and run detection are separate operations.

No agent-finished event or changed-file batch is exposed in pinned SDK EventKind/Event, event ABI or manifest EVENT_KINDS. Unknown subscription names are rejected; Other is forward compatibility, not an event producer. ActionPerformed identifies action invocation, not asynchronous agent completion. This excludes only the precise agent-finished trigger, not helper generation/manual/on-save workflows.

unqualifiedBaselineQuestions.reason: Public process-tab announcement does not establish restart persistence semantics.
Official routing documentation explicitly excludes it; our reviewed route rename is an extra capability.
